heading: What we do.
intro: Hire us for one service or several. Each stands on its own, and they work together when a problem crosses your systems and your books.

cards.label: Keep
cards.title: Bookkeeping
cards.body: Monthly bookkeeping owned by an IRS Enrolled Agent with more than 25 years in accounting, so your numbers answer the questions you are actually asking.
bullets: Full-cycle monthly bookkeeping and month-end close
QuickBooks Online setup, cleanup, and ongoing books
Multi-entity books and connected financial workflows
Direct communication with the person responsible for the work

cards.label: Connect
cards.title: System Integration
cards.body: Connect the software you already use so information moves between systems without being copied, re-entered, or chased down.
bullets: Connected intake that collects information once

cards.label: Automate
cards.title: Workflow Automation
cards.body: Take predictable back-office steps out of your team’s hands, with clear rules and the judgment calls kept with people.

cards.label: Prioritize
cards.title: AI Operations Audit
cards.body: A three-week, fixed-fee assessment of where automation and AI would genuinely help, before you invest in building.
bullets: Implementation plan with cost and time estimates

bridge: The same team works across all of it, so when a workflow touches both operations and your books, you do not have to explain the business twice.
